jobs.name: Imdugud
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone transparent base sprite for DFGSim, a martial arts card fighting game. Input image 1 is STRICT STYLE REFERENCE ONLY (existing red human fighter), input image 2 is supporting STYLE REFERENCE ONLY (existing fox enemy); invent a new subject. Match their very thick dark brown-black outlines, simple geometric anatomy, chunky hands and feet, broad flat color shapes, at most one restrained flat shadow per shape, very sparse detail, approachable cartoon proportions. No realism, painterly rendering, gradients, texture, glow, particles, intricate decoration, scenery, ground plane, shadows cast onto background, text or labels. Exactly ONE character, full body completely inside the canvas with generous transparent margins on all sides including horns/wings. Three-quarter profile facing LEFT, combat ready, static readable guard pose, grounded feet, easy to animate later. True transparent background. Sumerian myth-inspired fantasy martial arts adaptation, not an archaeological reconstruction. Subject: Imdugud, the lion-headed eagle. An upright eagle-bodied martial artist with an unmistakable golden lion head, small blocky ochre mane, tawny lion muzzle and rounded ears (NO eagle beak), dark slate-blue eagle wings folded into two clear guarded forelimb silhouettes, strong ochre bird legs and large simple three-toed talons. Keep folded wing silhouettes compact enough for a fight arena. A plain cream short wrap around the waist with a muted ochre belt, a few large feather shapes only. Proud alert expression. Build the silhouette around lion head plus eagle body and talons, not a griffin or human with extra wings.
